title: Passwordless sudo grant (shell) — review required
description: Sudoers configuration grants passwordless execution: deploy ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL. Any process as that user gains the listed privileges without authentication, so one compromised account or script escalates silently. This lexical rule flags the grant; the reviewer confirms the scope is minimal or requires a password.
remediation: Scope the grant to exact binaries (exact-command scoping) or drop NOPASSWD so authentication gates it.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the tag regardless of command scope.

tests.line: # audit: deploy ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL present
